newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort cuts Laura Ashley.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort cuts Laura Ashley.

text.p: Analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson on Monday shaved their earnings forecasts for retailer Laura Ashley Holdings Plc for the second time since the company issued a profits warning last month.
Industry analysts had revised profit forecasts to around 20 million stg after the company said this year's profits would fall short of expectations.

But analysts at house broker Kleinwort Benson cut their current year forecast again to 17.5 million stg and the following year's estimate was reduced to 22 million stg. The analysts maintain their "hold" rating on the stock.
